The '''''Hand of Justice''''' was an [[Arquitens-class light cruiser/Legends|''Arquitens''-class light cruiser]], commanded by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Coburn/Legends|Coburn]] during an [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|operation]] to rescue [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from a [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|Zygerrian slave processing facility]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].
